name: screenshot_tour
_comment: T156 review run (not a suite verdict; run: run_suite.py --only screenshot_tour). client_1 rendered under Xvfb; PNGs at spawn, firing (tick 90), first damage (server kill_mech amount 150), death (squad picker), match end (result screen) -> run1/client_1.hud_<tag>.png. Agent reviews them against the T156 checklist; ambiguous -> NEEDS_HUMAN.md. Server ticks are wall-paced; the rendered client runs ~4x slow, so shots are event-driven.
_checklist: every shot: 3D scene rendered (no black/magenta frame), HUD drawn on top, text legible against the scene behind it
spawn/firing: health bar top-left, team bars + lives + beacon rings top, crosshair centred, one icon per weapon bottom-right at full size with slot number + ammo bar
damaged: health bar shorter by the damage taken (150/500 here)
dead: scene dimmed, SELECT NEXT MECH picker lists the remaining squad, team lives count drops
match_end: result banner matches the winner (client team lost here), table readable, BACK TO LOBBY visible
not covered: lock ring / red aim box (lock needs ~25 s of aiming at 4x slow render), spectate, other loadouts (menu_flow shot covers Kestrel ARC+SHOTGUN)
